title: DL560 Codex session-3 cannot use TermAl mailbox: MCP tool needs approval under policy never, CLI gets connection denied
outcome: A remote Codex root session that is meant to act as a runner can read and send TermAl mail. The termal-delegation mailbox tools are usable without an interactive approval it can't get, and the TERMAL_CLI connection to its host isn't blocked by the session's sandbox, or the host tells the operator which session setting prevents it.
acceptance: DL560 Codex session-3 cannot use TermAl mailbox: MCP tool needs approval under policy never, CLI gets connection denied is done
